_about: Numbers from the pre-registered simulation study (runs S4, S4b, S4c). T1 = MuJoCo Panda pick-lift-transport; mass jump x2 mid-transport; 720 episodes per (eta, configuration).

configs.C3: chunk preview, fixed worst-case blind steps
configs.C4: chunk preview, latency-aware blind steps m (proposed)
configs.Cor: open-loop conservative reference: slow from the start, full grip

S4b_H1b.note: rate-limited gripper 10 N/s; recoverable cells, both zero drops

S4_H2.note: latency-aware preview (C4) faster than fixed worst-case preview (C3) at equal drop rate; reproduced in S4b and S4c (C4 faster in 95.5% of pairs in S4c)
